title: Android BSP Engineer
description:
About Stripe  
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.  
  About the team  
 Stripe Terminal helps Stripe users extend their online presence into the physical world. The Terminal team’s mission is to make it as easy for businesses to accept in-person payments as the Stripe API has done for online payments. With Terminal, businesses can unlock in-person payments use cases that are right for their business model—whether it’s creating a flagship retail experience, extending their website to a pop-up store, or enabling a mobile point-of-sale at their next event.  
  What we are looking for:  
 As an Android BSP Engineer, you will be responsible for the kernel and driver level system development, which includes building, troubleshooting, and writing automated tests for the Android system on our embedded payments platforms. This team works closely with partner teams throughout the hardware and software product lifecycle, from hardware manufacturing to Android app teams. We also work with external vendors on part selection and initial hardware bring-up. 
  What you’ll do:  
 
 Bring up new devices and lead debugging and performance tuning exercises that span multiple hardware/firmware/software teams. 
 Design, implement, and maintain drivers and Android services that operate efficiently in a constrained environment and meet the reliability and security requirements of the industry. 
 Own the definition of one or more work streams focused on hardware bring-up, peripheral drivers and communication, and power and performance management and optimization. 
 Analyze bug reports and manage the defect resolution process (disposition issues, resolve issues, and report issue status). 
 Interact with global teams with excellent communication skills to provide support information 
 Routinely perform code reviews to ensure high quality designs and implementation 
 Assist in ensuring quality and timeliness of product/feature development. Work closely with QA staff to ensure appropriate test cases are created, maintained, and executed. 
 Proactively solve problems and work independently and within a team environment, with limited guidance. 
 
  Who you are  
 We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. 
  Minimum requirements  
 
 2+ years software engineering experience in device driver development, embedded systems, or operating systems 
 2+ years working with mobile or other connected devices 
 Experience using automated testing, build systems, and inter-component communication protocols such as UART, GPIO, SPI, I2C, etc. 
 Proficiency in C/C++ or Kotlin/Java 
 Experience with Android OS, and familiarity with associated software development tools 
 Degree in CS, CE, EE, or equivalent practical experience 
 Experience adding, monitoring and parsing telemetry data to proactively resolve issues 
 Fluency in both written and spoken English and Mandarin Chinese to be able to communicate with our vendors and users/customers 
 
  Preferred qualifications  
 
 Experience with ARM platform 
 Experience working with microcontrollers 
 Knowledge of EMV. 
 Knowledge of cryptography, symmetric, asymmetric, key management and exchange is an asset. 
 Experience with POS Hardware and peripherals. 
 Knowledge and expertise of PCI technology, transaction processing, and related retail standards.

 Apply ergonomics and human factors principles to ensure products are intuitive and comfortable for a diverse range of users and environments. 
 Maintain visual consistency and brand coherence across the Terminal hardware product family, in alignment with Stripe's design identity.

title: Senior Research Engineer
description:
Flow Traders is looking for a Senior Research Engineer to join our   Hong Kong office. This is a unique opportunity to join a leading proprietary trading firm with an entrepreneurial and innovative culture at the heart of its business. We value quick-witted, creative minds and challenge them to make full use of their capacities.  
 As a Senior Research Engineer, you will be responsible for helping to lead the development of our trading model research framework and using it to conduct research to develop models for trading in production. You'll expand the framework to become global standard way of training, consuming, combining, and transforming any data source in a data-driven systematic way. You will then partner with Quantitative Researchers to build the trading models themselves. 
 What You Will Do 
 
 Help to lead the development and global rollout of our research framework for defining and training models through various optimization procedures (supervised learning, backtesting etc.), as well as its integration with our platform for deploying and running those models in production 
 Partner with Quantitative Researchers to conduct research: test hypotheses and tune/develop data-driven systematic trading strategies and alpha signals 
 
 What You Need to Succeed 
 
 Advanced degree (Master's or PhD) in Machine Learning, Statistics, Physics, Computer Science or similar 
 5+ years of hands-on experience MLOps, Research Engineering, or ML Research 
 A strong background in mathematics and statistics 
 Strong proficiency in programming languages such as Python, with experience in libraries like numpy, pytorch, polars, pandas, and ray. 
 Demonstrated experience in designing and implementing end-to-end machine learning pipelines, including data preprocessing, model training, deployment, and monitoring 
 Understanding of and experience with modern software development practices and tools (e.g. Agile, version control, automated testing, CI/CD, observability) 
 Understanding of cloud platforms (e. g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and containerization technologies (e. g., Docker, Kubernetes)

All resumes, and any other information identifying potential candidates, submitted to any employee at Flow Traders via-email, the Internet or directly without a valid and signed search agreement will be deemed free to contact by Flow Traders without any restrictions and no placement fee of any kind will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Flow Traders.

 作为产品总监，您需要深刻洞察高校财务管理的本质、行业演进趋势与前沿技术潜能，构建并持续迭代我们的产品愿景与战略。您将作为连接商业、技术、用户与市场的核心枢纽，全面负责产品的商业成功、市场竞争力与用户体验，带领团队打造国内具有行业影响力的高校财务解决方案。
 核心职责：
 1. 产品战略与规划： 负责公司核心产品线的整体战略制定，定义产品愿景、市场定位与长期发展路线图。 深入研究高校财务、信息化及相关领域的政策、市场、竞品与用户，识别并把握战略性机会。构建并持续优化产品组合，确保产品规划与公司整体业务战略高度协同。
 2. 产品体系构建与管理： 主导复杂产品体系（可能涵盖多个模块或产品线）的顶层设计，确保架构的扩展性、安全性与前瞻性。 建立并完善产品管理体系与流程，包括需求管理、版本规划、发布策略与生命周期管理规范。 对产品关键决策（如重大功能、技术架构选型、合作/并购等）进行评审与把关，控制产品风险。 
3. 团队建设与领导： 组建、培养和发展一支高绩效的产品经理与产品设计师团队，打造优秀的产品文化。
4. 商业成功与市场协同： 深度参与商业策略制定，对产品的市场占有率、收入目标、盈利能力及客户满意度（NPS）等关键商业指标负责。 ◦ 与销售、市场、实施、客户成功等部门紧密协同，确保产品策略能有效转化为市场优势与客户价值。 指导关键客户/生态伙伴的战略级沟通与合作，从产品层面驱动商业增长。
 5. 产品创新与竞争力打造：关注前沿技术（如AI、大数据、低代码等）在财务与信息化领域的应用，驱动产品持续创新，构建核心壁垒。

1. 基本条件： 985统招本科及以上学历，计算机、软件工程、信息管理、金融、经济等相关专业背景。 10年以上软件/互联网产品工作经验，至少5年以上中大型To B/To G/SaaS产品团队管理经验，担任过产品总监、高级产品总监或同等职位。 拥有从0到1打造并规模化复杂企业级软件产品的完整成功经验，并主导过产品的重大战略转型或版本演进。
 2. 关键能力与经验：
优秀的战略思维与商业洞察： 具备将市场趋势、客户痛点转化为清晰产品战略和可行路线图的能力，对财务、ERP、企业服务或政府/高校信息化领域有深刻理解和独到见解。 
 出色的产品领导力与组织影响力： 拥有丰富的跨部门（研发、销售、市场、服务等）协同和资源整合经验，能驱动复杂组织为共同的产品目标高效协作。
成熟的产品管理与体系建设能力： 精通产品管理全流程方法论，并能结合公司实际建立和优化产品管理体系，具备优秀的产品判断与决策能力。 ◦ 深厚的技术理解力与用户同理心： 能与技术团队就架构、实现进行高效对话，同时能深刻洞察用户（决策者、管理者、操作者）的多层次需求，追求极致的用户价值与商业价值的平衡。
 3. 核心素质：
 强烈的企业家精神、事业心与责任感，以产品成功和客户成功为己任。 出色的沟通表达能力、逻辑思维能力与复杂问题解决能力。 ◦ 开放的心态，强大的学习能力与抗压能力，能在不确定环境中寻找方向。 ◦ 具备领导的格局、胸怀与感召力。

title: 全栈工程师（Java × AI Agent）
company: 江苏极光云能新能源有限公司
description: 我们在做一件在欧洲电力市场里真正"跑得动钱"的事。 欧洲电力市场正在从"少数大型机组集中调度"转向"海量分布式资产聚合参与"。Aether 是我们的虚拟电厂（VPP）平台：把储能、可调负荷、分布式发电聚合起来，作为一个可控整体，去参与欧洲各国的电力市场交易与电网辅助服务。 Aether 今天支撑的业务链路是这样的： 多国多市场投标：mFRR（手动频率恢复备用）、FCR（频率控制备用）、ID / IDA（日内连续与拍卖）、DA（日前），覆盖各国不同的申报格式、时段颗粒度、容量与能量价格规则； 中标与自动激活：接收 TSO / 交易所的激活指令，把指令翻译成具体资产的功率设定点，下发、回执、闭环确认； 交付与合规：交付过程中的实时监测、偏差处理、baseline 计算，满足各国对备用容量的可用性与响应时间要求； 出帐与结算：容量费、能量费、不平衡结算、跨市场收益归因，对账到每一笔成交； 报表与复盘：面向交易员、运营和客户的对账报表、绩效看板、监管报送。 这是一个强实时、强合规、和真金白银强耦合的系统。一次激活没接住，损失的是一笔容量费；一次结算算错，损失的是客户的信任。 你将负责什么 1. 交易与交付主线（核心，约占 60%） - 参与 mFRR / FCR / ID / DA 各市场的接入开发：对接 TSO 与交易所接口（ENTSO-E、各国 TSO 平台、Nord Pool 等），处理申报、确认、激活、回执全流程； - 把"各国规则差异"抽象成可配置的模型，而不是每个国家写一套 if-else——这是我们最看重的架构能力； - 构建高可用的实时链路：激活指令的接收延迟、幂等、重试、降级、审计留痕； - 参与出帐与结算模块：计量数据接入、baseline 计算、结算单生成、与客户对账。 2. 平台工程（约 20%） - 服务拆分与边界治理，JVM 性能与稳定性调优，关键链路的可观测性（指标 / 日志 / 链路追踪）； - 数据层：时序数据（计量、功率曲线）与业务数据的存储选型与查询优化； - 与运维一起把发布、灰度、回滚做成日常操作，而不是事故演练。 3. AI 能力落地（约 20%，成长空间最大） - 规则与文档智能：各国市场规则文档（数百页、多语言）的解析、抽取、结构化，做成可检索、可追溯的知识库，让"某国 mFRR 的申报截止时间是多少"这类问题不需要人去翻 PDF； - RAG 工程：文档切分策略、embedding 选型、混合检索与重排、引用溯源、效果评测（不是"感觉还行"，而是有 eval set 和指标）； - Agent 与工具调用：基于 MCP 把内部系统（订单、成交、结算、监控）暴露成工具，让智能体能真正"查数据、跑分析、生成报表"，而不是只会聊天； - AI 辅助业务：申报前的一致性校验、异常交付的归因分析、报表自动生成与解释； - 关注 prompt 工程、上下文管理、成本与延迟控制、幻觉与越权的防护边界。

推动能源监控、能效分析、运行诊断、主动寻优、节能效果评估等功能的标准化与产品化。 - 协调产品、算法、平台研发及项目交付团队，推动产品从需求定义、研发实现到项目应用的完整闭环。 ### 2. 主动寻优算法项目落地 - 协助推进公司主动寻优算法在冷水机房及其他综合能源项目中的实施，参与项目调研、技术方案设计、实施计划制定和现场应用协调。 - 对接客户、销售、项目交付及技术团队，梳理项目现场设备配置、控制逻辑、运行数据、通信协议及可写控制点等关键条件，识别算法落地的前置条件与实施风险。 - 协同算法研发人员，将主动寻优算法转化为可实施的项目方案，明确算法输入输出、控制策略、设备联动逻辑、运行边界及异常处理机制。 - 跟踪算法接入、联调测试、试运行和正式投运全过程，协调解决数据质量、设备接口、控制权限、现场工况及系统兼容性等问题。 - 建立算法落地验收机制，跟踪运行稳定性、控制执行成功率、能效改善情况及节能收益，推动项目效果验证与验收。 - 总结不同项目的共性需求、实施难点及解决方案，沉淀标准化实施流程、配置模板、调试手册和验收规范，降低后续项目的交付成本。 ### 3. 跨部门项目推进与协同 - 研究暖通及综合能源领域的运行管理、能效提升和智能控制需求，持续完善场景化产品方案。 - 协助将暖通机理模型、能耗数据分析及AI能力融入平台产品，推动诊断、优化、控制和效果评估形成业务闭环。 - 整理项目运行数据、典型工况、算法应用效果及用户反馈，为算法优化和产品迭代提供依据。 - 编制产品说明书、解决方案、应用案例及内部培训材料，支持销售推广和项目复制。 ## 二、任职要求 1. **学历与专业：** 本科及以上学历，建筑环境与能源应用工程、能源与动力工程、供热供燃气通风及空调工程、能源管理、自动化等相关专业；双一流院校毕业优先。 2. **业务理解：** 具备暖通空调、中央空调冷站或综合能源系统的基础知识，能够理解冷水机组、冷冻水泵、冷却水泵、冷却塔及末端系统的运行逻辑。 3. **产品能力：** 具备需求分析、业务流程梳理、原型设计、PRD编写及版本规划能力；熟悉平台软件产品的研发与交付流程。 4. **项目推进：** 具备较强的跨部门沟通、任务拆解、进度跟踪和问题闭环能力，能够推动技术方案在实际项目现场实施。 5. **数据与技术理解：** 能够理解设备运行数据、控制点位、通信接口及算法输入输出；具备基础数据分析能力，熟悉 Excel、SQL 或 Python 者优先。 6. **AI应用认知：** 对AI大模型、AI Agent、机理模型、预测优化控制等技术有兴趣，能够借助AI工具提升需求分析、数据处理和产品设计效率。 7. **工作特质：** 具备较强的责任心、主动性和结果导向意识，能够适应研发协同、项目现场调研及多项目并行推进。 ## 三、优先条件 - 参与过能源管理平台、楼宇自控系统（BAS）、工业互联网平台或综合能源管理系统的产品设计与实施。 - 有中央空调冷站节能改造、能效优化、群控系统或自动控制项目经验。 - 熟悉 PLC、Modbus、BACnet、OPC UA 等工业控制或通信技术。 - 了解模型预测控制（MPC）、设备群控、能效寻优或其他优化控制技术。 - 有从项目交付中提炼标准产品需求、推动平台功能复用的经验。 ## 四、岗位核心交付成果 1. **平台产品交付：** 产品需求文档、原型设计、版本规划及需求验收记录。 2. **算法落地交付：** 项目现场条件调研表、算法实施方案、点位与接口清单、联调测试记录、试运行报告及验收材料。 3. **项目管理交付：** 主动寻优项目台账、实施计划、问题清单及风险跟踪记录。 4.

title: Silicon Alliances Ecosystem Development Manager - APAC
description:
The role of a Silicon Alliances Ecosystem Development Manager at Canonical 
 Ubuntu is the fastest growing enterprise Linux, the leading platform for public cloud computing, and the engineer's favorite way to drive the future.  
 Our goal is to help the enterprise embrace open source from end to end, across every class of compute and every class of application, starting with the linux kernel itself, to infrastructure solutions like OpenStack and Kubernetes, all the way up to data, security, analytics and serverless capabilities.  
 The Silicon Alliances Team works with the leading semiconductor companies  to combine open source adoption with innovative optimizations to get the most from each new chip. With our semiconductor partners, we develop joint product roadmaps, drive delivery, formulate go-to-market plans and conceptualize new business models, enabling differentiated hardware and robust product life-cycle support while still anchored to best-in-class Ubuntu. The end goal is a frictionless experience to deploy, maintain, and develop on any hardware from cloud to edge.  
 The successful candidate is someone who is passionate about both hardware and software technology with interest to grow into business development.  We are hiring for positions across early career to senior roles, with scope ranging from small exploratory partnerships to managing our largest and most strategic partnerships. 
 If you are someone who can navigate complex new technical challenges, learn quickly, and architect solutions and strategies across global teams, this challenging role is for you. 
  Location:   We are for hybrid work; mix of on-site in our Taipei office and remote from home.   Global travel to sprints, events, and partner meetings is part of the role. 
 What your day will look like  
 
 Represent Canonical, its solutions and software to partners. 
 Develop a deep understanding of silicon partner strategies, technologies and roadmaps and identify overlap with Canonical’s current and future products.

description:
Join the Future of Security at Netskope 
 Netskope (NASDAQ: NTSK) is a leader in modern security and networking for the cloud and AI era. We secure and accelerate cloud, data, and AI in real time, everywhere. Thousands of customers, including more than 30 of the Fortune 100, trust the Netskope One platform, its Zero Trust Engine, and the powerful NewEdge network to gain full visibility and control without performance trade-offs. 
 At Netskope, our technology is driven by our greatest strength: our people. We believe that belonging powers innovation, and success is both personal and organizational. We embrace differences in gender, ethnicity, beliefs, ability, and identity, creating an environment where every voice is heard and respected. We empower our employees to bring their authentic selves to work, grow their careers through continuous education and mentorship, and lead with transparency and curiosity. Join a team where you belong, where you are encouraged to be an entrepreneur, and where together, we continue to redefine the landscape of security. 
 Visit  Careers at Netskope  to learn more. Follow us on  LinkedIn  and  Instagram .    Please note, this team is hiring across all levels and candidates are individually assessed and appropriately leveled based upon their skills and experience.  
  About the Role  
 Netskope AI Gateway helps global enterprises securely adopt, scale, and govern Generative AI. We are seeking a  Staff / Sr. Staff Software Engineer  to architect, build, and scale the core systems powering our AI Gateway product and its supporting microservices across SaaS and on-prem/hybrid environments. 
 Based in Taiwan, you will be a technical anchor for our core development team. This is a hands-on, high-impact individual contributor role focused on building highly scalable backend systems, with real ownership: the systems assigned to you are yours to design, build, and defend — depth matters more than volume. You will operate at the intersection of deep distributed systems engineering and cutting-edge AI technology. We are looking for an engineering leader who leverages AI to accelerate their workflows, but possesses the rigorous, production-grade coding skills required to architect complex systems, ensure enterprise-grade security, and validate AI-generated code. 
  What You Will Be Doing  
 
  Core Backend Development:  Architect, build, and scale our core AI Gateway solutions, backend services, and high-throughput APIs. You will focus on writing highly concurrent, robust, and maintainable software, primarily in  Golang . 
  Command AI-Driven Engineering:  Integrate AI and agent-based tooling (e.g., Copilots, code generators) into your daily development workflow to accelerate scaffolding, boilerplate, and hypothesis generation.  Crucially, you will act as the gatekeeper:  you must possess the deep software engineering expertise to audit AI-generated code, ensure architectural soundness, and reject code that introduces technical debt or security flaws. 
  Design for Scale and Resilience:  Build distributed systems capable of handling immense data payloads, streaming LLM responses (Server-Sent Events), and complex proxy routing without introducing unacceptable latency. 
  Cross-Functional Collaboration:  Partner directly with global engineering, AI researchers, and product teams. Translate ambitious AI features into scalable, maintainable software architectures. Raise system design considerations before a single line of feature code is written. 
  Push Engineering Excellence:  Drive the technical culture of the Taiwan team through architectural reviews, code reviews, and mentorship. Advocate for best practices in modern, AI-augmented software development, security, and scalable system design. 
  Deep Systems Debugging:  While not primarily an incident support role, you will be the ultimate escalation point for the hardest systemic development roadblocks. Trace complex issues across asynchronous microservice

title: Operations Specialist
description:
Flow Traders is looking for an experienced Operations Specialist to join our APAC team in Hong Kong. The ideal candidate is analytically strong, proactive, and motivated to work in a fast-paced trading environment. This is a unique opportunity to join a leading proprietary trading firm where operational excellence, automation, and continuous improvement are at the core of how we work. 
 The Operations team is responsible for trade lifecycle management, reconciliations, settlement, and control processes that directly support our trading desks. We are building a team that goes beyond traditional mid/back-office execution: we expect our specialists to deeply understand process flows and business logic, design better solutions, and leverage AI and other tools to implement them. What matters most is the ability to analyse how things work, identify what should change, and manage the migration. 
 The role sits within our broader first-line controls function, which encompasses our traditional operations function and other First-Line controls, trade reporting, and data management. As we continue to integrate and develop this function, there are opportunities to broaden your scope beyond traditional operations into these adjacent areas, offering a varied and rewarding career path for the right candidate. 
 What You Will Do 
 
 Perform daily trade reconciliations, position monitoring, P&L attribution, and cash/cost reconciliation across multiple asset classes and prime brokers 
 Investigate and resolve trade breaks, settlement issues, and corporate action events in a timely manner, liaising with counterparties, custodians, and prime brokers 
 Analyse existing operational processes end-to-end, map business logic and data flows, and design improved solutions that reduce manual effort and error rates 
 Leverage AI-assisted development tools and scripting (Python, SQL) to build and maintain automated reconciliation, reporting, and control workflows 
 Manage and improve data pipelines that feed control and reporting workflows, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of operational data 
 Support the onboarding of new counterparties, prime brokers, and market connectivity, including SSI setup and operational readiness testing 
 Contribute to the APAC delivery of global technology and process improvement projects, collaborating with Technology teams to define requirements and validate outputs 
 Monitor and manage operational risk throughout the trade lifecycle, escalating issues proactively and contributing to root-cause analysis and remediation 
 
 What You Need to Succeed 
 
 3+ years of mid/back-office or operations experience, preferably within a proprietary trading firm, hedge fund, or prime brokerage 
 Strong technical literacy: you must be able to read, understand, and reason about code (Python, SQL) and data structures, whether you write it yourself or work with AI tools to generate it 
 Demonstrated ability to analyse complex process flows, understand the underlying business logic, and translate that into clear, implementable solution designs 
 Solid understanding of trade lifecycle processes across listed equities, ETFs, futures, FX, and/or OTC derivatives 
 Experience with reconciliation frameworks, clearing and settlement workflows, and familiarity with Asian securities markets and their respective rules 
 Comfort working with AI-assisted development and productivity tools to accelerate solution delivery 
 Ability to work with large datasets, perform analysis, and translate findings into actionable process improvements 
 Excellent communication and problem-solving skills, with a proactive, assertive, and flexible approach 
 Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage a diverse range of tasks efficiently in a fast-paced environment 
 Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field

title: Software Engineer | Post Trade Analytics
description:
Jump Trading Group is committed to world-class research. We empower exceptional talent in Mathematics, Physics, and Computer Science to seek scientific boundaries, push through them, and apply cutting-edge research to global financial markets. Our culture is unique. Constant innovation requires fearlessness, creativity, intellectual honesty, and a relentless competitive streak. We measure, analyze, and optimize every dimension of our trading activity across all global markets. Our team builds the foundational analyses that traders and quantitative researchers rely on daily to make critical decisions. As a Data Engineer on the PTA team, you will own the critical datasets and pipelines upon which our trading decisions are built, all while developing in-depth technical and financial business expertise.

 Partner directly with traders and quantitative researchers to turn complex questions into data products that shape how we trade across global markets.

 Directly influence business priorities, trading strategies, and execution quality through high-impact data engineering. 
 Guarantee trust in the numbers by building robust data validation frameworks, monitoring, alerting, data lineage, and executing rapid incident response. 
 Drive performance by optimizing data processing and workflows for speed, cost, and resilience, while diagnosing and resolving the most complex pipeline and production issues. 
 Develop and optimize the tools, documentation, and foundational infrastructure that empower the broader research and trading teams. 
 Other duties as needed 
 
  Skills You’ll Need:  
 
 3+ years of experience as a Data Engineer or Software Engineer working extensively with large-scale data. 
 Proficiency in Python or C++ (Strong skills in at least one, with a willingness to work across both). 
 Proven expertise in building, operating, and scaling ETL/ELT pipelines, including orchestration, scheduling, and dependency management. 
 Strong command of SQL and the broader data analytics ecosystem, including familiarity with libraries such as Pandas and NumPy. 
 Sharp analytical and problem-solving abilities, paired with a strong curiosity to understand the financial business logic behind the data. 
 Comfort and proficiency working within Linux environments. 
 Reliable and predictable availability

title: Junior Quantitative Researcher - Deep Learning (Time Series)
description:
About Akuna:  
 Akuna Capital is an innovative trading firm with a strong focus on collaboration, cutting-edge technology, data driven solutions and automation. We specialize in providing liquidity as an options market maker – meaning we are committed to providing competitive quotes that we are willing to both buy and sell. To do this successfully we design and implement our own low latency technologies, trading strategies and mathematical models. 
 Our Founding Partners, including Akuna's CEO Andrew Killion, first conceptualized Akuna in their hometown of Sydney. They opened the firm’s first office in 2011 in the heart of the derivatives industry and the options capital of the world – Chicago. Today, Akuna is proud to operate from additional offices in Shanghai, Sydney, Singapore and London. 
 At Akuna, we believe that the people are the centre of everything we do. Akuna Software Technologies was our first international office and opened in the Fall of 2014. Our Shanghai office works with the latest hardware and software technologies to develop high performance low latency solutions that are robust and scalable, ensuring our strategies are as fast as possible for Akuna’s global trading operations. We run happy hours, have a fully stacked snack room with free drinks and fresh fruits, host team events, social club events, and offer great training with our Akuna University. We are looking for the best talent to join us on the journey. If you enjoy being part of smart, driven teams with real challenges to solve- this could be the place for you! 
  What you’ll do as a Junior Quantitative Researcher at Akuna:  
 We're looking for a Junior Quantitative Researcher who will work specifically on deep learning projects involving large-scale time series data. Strong preference for candidates with hands-on DL experience over general ML/data science backgrounds. In this role you will: 
 
 Develop trading strategies using statistical and deep learning technologies 
 Design and implement optimization algorithms for portfolio construction 
 Develop quantitative models describing market behavior 
 Advance existing initiatives and explore opportunities for new research topics 
 
  Qualities that make great candidates:  
 
 Bachelors, Masters or PhD in a technical field – Engineering, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics (or a related subject),  graduate(d) during Jul 2023 - Jul 2027  
  Deep learning experience is required:  hands-on work with neural network architectures (e.g., RNNs, LSTMs, Transformers, TCNs, or similar) applied to sequential or time series data — through research, working projects, competitions, or internships 
 Programming skills: Strong Python programming experience, including familiarity with DL frameworks (PyTorch and/or TensorFlow); C++ knowledge is a plus 
 Experience handling large-scale datasets efficiently — data pipelines, batching, and training at scale (GPU experience is a plus) 
 Solid foundation in math and statistics, with the ability to translate real-world, noisy, high-dimensional problems into mathematical/DL models 
 Prior exposure to time series-specific challenges (non-stationarity, autocorrelation, forecasting, sequence modeling) is a strong plus 
 Financial experience is not a requirement 
 Willing to communicate in English at the technical interviews     
 
  Please note:   If you apply to multiple roles, you may be asked to complete multiple coding challenges and interviews.

title: Staff SDET, AI Gateway
description:
Join the Future of Security at Netskope 
 Netskope (NASDAQ: NTSK) is a leader in modern security and networking for the cloud and AI era. We secure and accelerate cloud, data, and AI in real time, everywhere. Thousands of customers, including more than 30 of the Fortune 100, trust the Netskope One platform, its Zero Trust Engine, and the powerful NewEdge network to gain full visibility and control without performance trade-offs. 
 At Netskope, our technology is driven by our greatest strength: our people. We believe that belonging powers innovation, and success is both personal and organizational. We embrace differences in gender, ethnicity, beliefs, ability, and identity, creating an environment where every voice is heard and respected. We empower our employees to bring their authentic selves to work, grow their careers through continuous education and mentorship, and lead with transparency and curiosity. Join a team where you belong, where you are encouraged to be an entrepreneur, and where together, we continue to redefine the landscape of security. 
 Visit  Careers at Netskope  to learn more. Follow us on  LinkedIn  and  Instagram .    Please note, this team is hiring across all levels and candidates are individually assessed and appropriately leveled based upon their skills and experience.  
  About the Role  
  Netskope AI Gateway  helps global enterprises securely adopt and scale Generative AI. We are looking for a  Staff Software Development Engineer in Test  (SDET) to own quality for significant areas of the AI Gateway product, its supporting services, and its APIs, across SaaS and on-prem/hybrid customer environments. 
 This is a hands-on individual-contributor role with real ownership. The areas assigned to you are yours: you set the testing direction and build what is needed to execute it, bringing hard calls to the QE lead as a peer rather than waiting for a specification or a checklist before you act. 
 Depth matters more than volume in this role. We are looking for someone who can get a long way into an ambiguous problem before needing help, go deep when a failure crosses service, infrastructure, and network boundaries, and work directly with developers and product managers to get the underlying problem fixed rather than routed around. 
  What You Will Be Doing  
 
  Own Quality for Your Areas:  For the features and services assigned to you, own the outcome: reliability, correctness, performance, security-related behaviors, and user experience expectations. Decide what needs testing and at which layer, set the bar for shipping that area, and be accountable for what gets through. 
  Turn Ambiguity into a Plan:  Start from partial requirements, an architecture diagram, and a conversation with the developer, and produce a concrete test approach. Surface the risks nobody has written down yet, decide which ones matter, and state clearly what you are choosing not to cover and why. 
  Build the Automation:  Design and implement the automated suites and the frameworks, harnesses, and fixtures behind them. Write them as real software: readable, maintainable, and quick to triage when they fail. Keep flakiness low through deterministic test design, environment isolation, and disciplined use of mocking and service virtualization. 
  Use AI Where It Earns Its Place:  Bring AI and agent-based tooling into the testing workflow: generating scaffolding and test data, navigating unfamiliar code, summarizing logs and failures, and shortening the path from symptom to hypothesis. Be equally clear about the limits. AI-generated tests can look thorough while asserting nothing that matters, so you check what the assertions actually prove. The tool can draft the work, but the coverage decision and the verdict stay yours. 
  Validate the Gateway Data Path:  Verify that AI Gateway stays compatible with the provider APIs it fronts, that policy matches exactly the requests it should, and that the resulting action and logging are correct.

This is a hands-on IC role with genuine ownership: you take services from design through production and are accountable for how they behave.  We work in an AI-augmented engineering culture. title: Senior Software Engineer, C++ (Market Data)
description:
Flow Traders Hong Kong is looking for a Senior C++ Software Engineer to lead the next-generation architecture of the market data and execution platforms that power our fully systematic trading. We don't treat market data as plumbing - for us it's a source of alpha, where feed handling, order book construction, and a deep understanding of exchange microstructure are themselves a competitive edge. We're looking for a senior individual contributor who has lived this philosophy in a proprietary or systematic trading environment and can squeeze every nanosecond out of the path from wire to strategy. 
 As a senior individual contributor, you'll be working on the Core Platform that underpins quantitative research, pricing, strategy development, and execution across hundreds of venues. You'll work in a tight, iterative loop with quants and technical traders, applying deep expertise in modern C++, OS internals, CPU and memory architecture, lock-free concurrency, and low-latency networking to push our systems toward state-of-the-art performance, robustness, and observability. 
 What you will do: 
 
 Design and implement high‑performance components for market data ingestion, normalization, and distribution, as well as its usage for order execution and strategy infrastructure. 
 Develop tools and frameworks that enable quants and technical traders to build, tune, and deploy data‑driven systematic pricing and trading strategies. 
 Own the full lifecycle of your components in a fast‑paced, iterative environment: deploy, monitor, profile, and optimize your code in production. 
 Work closely with focus group engineers, quants, and technical traders to refine requirements, collect feedback, and iterate on the platform's design and implementation. 
 
 What you need to succeed: 
 
 BSc, MSc, or PhD in Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related field. 
 5+ years of post‑graduation professional C++ software development experience. 
 Experience building low‑latency market data ingestion, order execution, and algorithmic trading systems (proprietary trading industry preferred). 
 Strong knowledge in one or more APAC markets.  
 Strong knowledge of algorithms and data structures. 
 Experience in parallel, asynchronous, and multithreaded programming. 
 Demonstrated ability to write clean, reliable, and highly scalable C++ code. 
 Interest in extracting maximum performance from available hardware and software (CPU caches, memory layout, networking, etc.). 
 Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non‑technical colleagues.

description:

 AppsFlyer helps the world's leading brands understand what their marketing is actually doing.  Our measurement, analytics and audience platform processes billions of events a day for customers who need to separate what works from what only looks like it works.  We were built by people who came out of the industry we serve, and staying close to that problem is still how we operate. 
 Measurement is being rebuilt right now. Platform privacy changes, the shift from deterministic attribution toward incrementality and modelling, and AI moving from a product feature to the way marketing decisions actually get made.  All of it lands on our roadmap and on our customers' desks at the same time. Greater China is where it plays out fastest.

 GCR is AppsFlyer's largest market in Asia and one of the most competitive measurement markets in the world. The General Manager owns the full regional P&L: revenue, margin, people, product relevance and market position. You'll set the strategy, build and hold the leadership team, and be the face of AppsFlyer to customers, platforms, partners, media and regulators in China. 
 This is a defend-and-grow mandate. The business is established and the brand is known. Growth from here comes from deepening our largest accounts, winning the outbound motion as Chinese apps and brands scale overseas, and making sure the platform solves the measurement problems Chinese marketers actually have.

 Own the full regional P&L: revenue, margin, and budget against plan

 Ensure full regulatory, data and labour compliance in partnership with Legal, Finance and People

 15+ years of commercial leadership, including at least 5 years owning a country or regional P&L 
 Accountability for a sizable recurring-revenue business and a multi-function organisation of 100+ people. 
 Track record of growing and managing a $100M+ business, across several segments.

 Experience owning both sides of the revenue equation: acquisition and retention
